concept_tasks.prompt: Cannonback, the shell-sentinel water turtle creature for a stylised 3D creature-collecting action RPG, the SAME character as the reference board images, unchanged identity. A massive heavy fortress turtle on four thick sturdy pillar legs with big cream-ivory claws. FACE: a clearly CREAM BEAKED FACE like the board head detail: the snout ends in a broad hooked snapping-turtle beak of smooth cream-ivory horn (#eadfc4); the whole lower face, jaw, chin and throat are pale cream; the upper head and brow are covered in ocean-blue scales; a warm amber-gold eye with a dark pupil under a heavy blue scaled brow; calm, steady expression. SHELL: a tall domed shell of stacked chunky slate-blue stone plates (#52729a) with olive-green moss (#6f7436) in the seams and a thin pale cream rim on each plate edge. CANNONS: three or four BIG BARREL CANNONS built into the top of the shell like the board: each a thick short wide barrel of weathered bronze-tan stone (#b8a070), almost as wide as the creature's head, with a heavy rounded rim and a deep dark round bore, two on the front shoulders of the shell angled forward-up and one or two on the rear top angled up, clearly readable large silhouettes, not thin pipes. SKIN: legs, neck, head and short tail covered in large clean deep ocean-blue scales (#2e5886) over cream skin, cream belly plastron. Stylised hand-painted creature-game look with clean large readable colour blocks, Palworld / Pokemon Legends style 3D render, not photoreal, no speckle, no noise, no yellow spots. Neutral four-legged standing stance, all four legs clearly separated from each other and from the belly with visible gaps, head facing forward and level, short tail, full body in frame, plain flat light grey background, even studio lighting, no water, no splash, no scenery, no text. Absolutely no red, pink, coral, maroon or oxblood anywhere. Single creature only, no rider, no saddle.
concept_tasks.verdict: rejected as model input: big barrel cannons and clear cream beak, but flat 2D-outline style and slim shell; used as a geometry anchor for c3/c4

variant_B.judges_asks: Art pass 3, three code-blind judges at the fight camera (bar 6.7): regen 1 scored 6.40, the best Cannonback. Asks: cannons ~15% smaller and seated deeper into the shell; moss patches in the shell seams; blue speckle on the cream limbs; a saddle notch so the rider straddles between the cannons. No red/oxblood.
variant_B.geometry: Not edited. Regen 1 is one connected manifold mesh (14,005 vertices; one island before and after position welding), so the cannons are not separable mesh islands. Cannon-size/seat-depth and saddle-notch asks are UNMET in this candidate; mesh, skin, rig and clips are byte-identical to regen 1.

style_tasks.prompt: The same stylised Water Cannonback tortoise creature as the reference renders: identical body shape, proportions, pose, hooked cream beak, amber eyes, legs, tail, shell plates and the three bronze barrel cannons, shown as a polished stylised 3D game creature render in a three-quarter view from the front-left that shows the face, one side of the body and the top of the shell, on a plain light grey background with even studio lighting. Keep the colour scheme of the reference and refine it: the shell plates are deep slate navy-blue (#2c4a6e) with soft lighter blue edges, and thick patches of soft olive-green moss (#5f7a34) grow IN THE SEAMS between the shell plates, filling the grooves and spilling a little onto the plate edges, clearly mossy and textured. The head, neck and the scaly upper legs are deep ocean blue scales. The cream skin of the lower legs, feet, throat and belly plastron (#e6dcc2) is covered with many small scattered BLUE SPECKLES and freckle spots (#3a6a9a) of varying size, densest near the blue scales and fading toward the toes, so the cream limbs read as speckled. Claws ivory. The three barrel cannons are aged bronze-brass with darker bands and a soft patina, matte. Stylised hand-painted Palworld-like 3D look, matte, not photoreal. No red, no pink, no orange, no maroon anywhere.
style_tasks.verdict: rejected: moss present but no visible limb speckle

style_tasks.prompt: Repaint the colours of this exact stylised Water Cannonback tortoise creature 3D render; keep the shape, pose, camera, beak, eyes, shell plates and the three bronze barrel cannons exactly as they are. Required texture changes, clearly visible: (1) EVERY cream / beige skin area (the front of the legs, the feet, the neck, throat and the belly plastron) is covered in DENSE BLUE SPECKLES: many small round dark-blue freckle dots (#2f5f92) of mixed size scattered all over the cream like a speckled bird egg or a leopard gecko, so no cream area is plain. (2) Bright olive-green moss (#6a8a36) fills EVERY groove and seam between the dark navy shell plates as a thick fuzzy mossy line, with a few small moss tufts on the plate edges. (3) The cannons stay aged matte bronze-brass. Shell plates deep slate navy, head and upper legs deep ocean-blue scales. Stylised hand-painted game look, matte, plain light grey background, even studio light. No red, no pink, no orange, no maroon anywhere.
style_tasks.verdict: chosen: dense blue speckle over all cream skin, moss filling every shell seam, bronze cannons; no red
